headline: No corner stacks — the warehouse keeps its bends clear
lede: Floor Boss learned a fifth aisle law this shift: you may not rack the cell facing a tight elbow, because the cart that services that rack parks in the one spot both legs of the bend have to pass. Stage 1 of #2627 is built, gated 203/203 and driven live — it is only waiting on red main to merge.

notes.text: NO CORNER STACKS (PR #2629, issue #2627): a click that would face a tight corner with a rack is refused at the point of sale — money not spent, no rack lands, the yard stays drivable. Real warehouse corner clearances, expressed as click-point geometry like #2546 and #2614 before it.

The floor length (CORNER_ARM 3) is derived, not styled: the elbow holds the work stop, and the game's own jam law (two waiting carts within two cells) needs two queue cells inside the walls. Shorter legs, bays, or a plugged dead-end all stay legal.

floorbosscheck 203/203 with a --mutate-corner kill that names the law, plus 13 new gates (both axes, both mirrors, three escapes, determinism, painter pin). Live drive floorbossplay 44/44, zero page errors.

Merge freeze, not code: nightly full-smoke failed at ce5d45f and the QA lane owns the repair (#2626/#2628). The instant main greens, #2629 squash-merges and #2627 stages 2–3 (teach the escape, readable swing grammar) are next.
